items.status_note: In force as of 2026-10-13. Metadata re-checked on vanban.chinhphu.vn on 2026-10-13. MOIT is drafting an amending law (see VN-DUTHAO-LUAT-SUADOI-TM-QLNT-CT-BVQLNTD-2026); the proposals published so far concern personal data, standard-form contracts and local-government roles, not misleading information.

key_provisions.summary: Defines người có ảnh hưởng (influencer): experts, reputable or socially followed persons.
Defines tiêu dùng bền vững (sustainable consumption) as use of goods/services that meets needs while minimising negative environmental and socio-economic impacts.

Prohibits deceiving or misleading consumers through false, incomplete or inaccurate information about the product, the business's reputation or capacity, transaction terms, or images, papers and certification documents of competent state agencies.

Businesses must give accurate, complete information on measurement, quantity, quality, uses, price and origin, and must label goods truthfully, clearly and accurately, reflecting the true nature of the goods.

A third party that carries product information must ensure accuracy, ask the business for documents proving accuracy, and is jointly liable for inaccurate information unless it took all legally required verification steps.
Influencers must meet the third-party duties and tell consumers in advance that they are sponsored.
Effective 01/07/2024.

Use as context for 'insufficient evidence', not to conclude a violation.

items.status_note: In force since 2026-01-01. Re-read from the signed text on 2026-10-13.

amends: Luật Thương mại 36/2005/QH11 (Điều 4.2; repeals Mục 2 Chương IV)

key_provisions.summary: Redefines advertising; defines người chuyển tải sản phẩm quảng cáo as a person who directly advertises, recommends or endorses products online or by wearing, attaching or displaying them for profit.
Prohibits comparing one's products with the same type of products of others without lawful substantiating documents.

Ad conveyors must follow consumer-protection and product-information rules, hand over related documents on request, and are legally responsible if content breaches Điều 19. Influencers must also verify the advertiser's reliability, check product documents, not promote products they have not used or do not understand, and announce the advertising before and during it.

Advertising content must be truthful, accurate and clear and must not mislead about features, quality, uses or effects; required notes and warnings must be as legible and audible as the rest of the ad.
Advertising content excludes mandatory label content, content that must be publicly disclosed or provided to customers, and content belonging to information-provision duties under other laws.
Commercial advertising is now governed by advertising law; repeals Section 2, Chapter IV of the Commercial Law.
Effective 01/01/2026; pending billboard/banner notifications follow the old law.

key_dates.what: Signed by Deputy PM Mai Văn Chính
Received/posted by the Government e-portal (VGP stamp)
In force; NĐ 181/2013 and NĐ 70/2021 cease (Điều 32)

key_provisions.summary: Special products list: cosmetics; food; infant milk/nutrition; household and medical chemicals and insecticides; medical devices; medical services; pesticides, veterinary drugs, animal and aquaculture feed, aquaculture-environment treatment products, livestock-waste treatment products, breeds; fertilisers; plant varieties; medicines; alcoholic drinks under 15 degrees and beer.

Mandatory content per special product (e.g. pesticides/veterinary drugs Điều 10: name, active ingredient, uses, hazard warnings; feed, aquaculture-environment and livestock-waste products Điều 11: name, features, responsible entity; fertilisers Điều 12: name, method of use, responsible entity; household chemicals Điều 7); cosmetics ads (Điều 4) must match the declared features and must not suggest a medicine; plant varieties, medicines and alcohol in Điều 13.
Non-fixed online ads must close with one interaction; no fake or hard-to-distinguish close buttons; no wait to close static image ads and at most 5 seconds for animated/video ads.
Advertisers, ad businesses, conveyors and publishers must block or remove illegal online ads within 24 hours of a written or electronic request from MOCST or the competent authority.

Online ad service businesses (domestic and foreign) notify MOCST before operating; keep ad records (identity, product, ad sample, contracts and documents related to the advertised product) for 3 years from the last day the ad was shown; report annually to MOCST by 25 November; intermediary platforms must show who bought each ad and search engines must mark sponsored results.
Licences under the old decrees stay valid; decree effective 15/02/2026; repeals NĐ 181/2013 and NĐ 70/2021.

items.title: Nghị định quy định xử phạt vi phạm hành chính trong lĩnh vực văn hóa và quảng cáo
items.title_vi: Nghị định xử phạt hành chính về văn hóa và quảng cáo (2026)

key_dates.what: Signed by Deputy PM Mai Văn Chính
Posted by the Government e-portal (VGP stamp)
In force (Điều 93.1); NĐ 38/2021, Điều 4 NĐ 129/2021 and NĐ 128/2022 cease (Điều 93.2)

items.status_note: In force since 2026-05-15 (Điều 93.1 of the signed text).

key_provisions.summary: Maximum advertising fine 100 million VND (individuals) / 200 million VND (organisations). Amounts in Chương II–III are for individuals (except listed articles); organisations pay double; sanctioning-authority caps are for individuals, doubled for organisations.
Posting ads on utility poles, traffic-signal poles or public trees: 5–10 million VND.
Using 'nhất', 'duy nhất', 'tốt nhất', 'số một' or similar without lawful substantiating documents: 10–20 million VND.
Comparing one's products with the same type of products of others without lawful substantiating documents: 40–60 million VND.

Untrue or misleading advertising about business capability, ability to supply, or quantity, quality, price, uses, design, packaging, brand, origin, type, service or warranty of registered/announced products: 80–100 million VND (organisations 160–200 million VND), except where a product-specific article applies.
Additional penalties for some breaches; remedies: take ads down; compelled correction of information (buộc cải chính thông tin) and surrender of illegal profits for khoản 3 điểm b and khoản 5 điểm c.

Influencers: 40–60 million VND for not verifying the advertiser, not checking product documents or incomplete announcement; 60–80 million VND for not announcing the advertising before and during it; 80–100 million VND for promoting products not used or understood; remedies include a public written apology.
Cosmetics advertising inconsistent with the product dossier, missing mandatory content, or using medical facilities' or professionals' images: 15–20 million VND.
Commune People's Committee chairs may fine up to 50 million VND for advertising violations (individual level).
Effective 15/05/2026; repeals NĐ 38/2021, Điều 4 of NĐ 129/2021 and NĐ 128/2022.

amends: Luật Chất lượng sản phẩm, hàng hóa 05/2007/QH12

key_provisions.summary: Defines hộ chiếu số của sản phẩm (digital product passport): product and supply-chain information stored in a barcode or linked database, readable by suitable devices.
Goods are classified by risk into low, medium and high risk.
Traceability and supply-chain transparency must be truthful, objective, authentic and verifiable; mandatory for high-risk goods on a roadmap set by each ministry; encouraged for others.
Technology in quality management: barcodes, traceability, electronic labels, digital passports and AI/big data, in line with the digital and circular economy; data must be secure.

Prohibits false information or advertising and deception about quality, origin and provenance (especially on digital platforms); concealing risk information affecting health, property or the environment; quality-related unfair competition causing confusion.
Producers must give truthful quality information, declare applicable standards, and label goods physically, electronically or by digital passport with traceability information.

Goods in circulation must carry physical/electronic labels or a digital passport with barcode, traceability and quality information and be updated in the electronic data system; online sellers and platform operators have information and complaint-handling duties.
